title: 第一卷 第27章 意志本源，世界之主！
novel_title: 开局自曝系统，家族助我娶妻成仙！
content_zh:
“帝子，已经商议好了，三生阁祖师于万年前在创生莲华界开宗立派，目的就是为了给此方小世界的苍生一份安定。只是后辈徒孙无能，这才让出云宗崛起，邪修横行……”

    “如今帝子携上界仙人斩除邪祟，肃清寰宇，三生阁自当继先祖遗志，守护界内苍生！”

    安祈雪躬身行礼，道出了三生阁的选择。

    对此，姜无痕也表示理解。

    他立刻召来一位圣人和两位劫境尊者，淡然道：“自今日起，尔等坐镇创生莲华界，为三生阁荣誉长老。坐镇期间，随时与家族汇报此方界内的情况，百年后我会派人来替换你们，待到回归姜家，月俸及其他待遇……提升一级！”

    坐镇小世界百年，回去之后，圣人享受圣人王待遇，尊者享受圣人待遇！

    这对他们来说，简直就是恩赐！

    “帝子放心，我等定不辱使命！”

    三人躬身，神态恭敬。

    姜无痕点头，随即看向安祈雪身旁，淡然道：“六长老，此方小世界的法则，还需要你来出手……”

    姜清濯从安祈雪身边走出，她始终守护着安祈雪，之前阻止她燃烧本源，并为其治愈伤势的，便是姜清濯！

    她点点头，从怀中取出一枚玲珑剔透的晶石，挥手打入了创生莲华界的地脉之中。

    “这是一枚中千世界的法则本源，取自十二万年前陨灭的‘海神界’，足以让创生莲华界成长为仅次于中千世界的小世界。”

    姜清濯解释道。

    三生阁众人闻言，神情震撼。

    随手拿出中千世界的法则本源，这是何等的手笔！

    那位老妪已经感受到了世界法则变化，对于境界的禁锢开始松动。

    她感觉，随时都能冲击阴阳境！

    并且，突破之后，无需飞升上界。

    就在这时，这方小世界之中的山川草木像是活过来一般，界内所有的一切，在此刻产生了共鸣。

    世界意志凝聚，化作了一枚光球，降临在了姜无痕面前。

    一瞬间，三生阁众人皆是神情一震。

    他们生于斯，长于斯，一眼就认出，那是创生莲华界的意志本源！

    世界凝聚出意志本源，代表着臣服！

    只要将其炼化，就能成为世界之主！

    三生阁历代祖师用尽各种办法，却始终没能成功。

    而此刻，创生莲华界主动臣服，献上意志本源。

    然而，姜无痕却连看都没看一眼，将其推到了安祈雪面前。

    “帝子，您这是……”

    安祈雪柳眉微蹙，不解道。

    “我不需要这东西，倒是你，似乎挺感兴趣的……”姜无痕轻笑，淡然道，“虽说，你今后成了我的帝子妃，不会再缺资源，但此方小世界，毕竟是你的根脚所在。”

    “你若成为此地的世界之主，今后无论身处何地，都能随时通过世界本源，回到创生莲华界。”
content_en:
"Emperor, we have already discussed it. The founder of Sansheng Pavilion founded a sect in the Creation Lotus Realm ten thousand years ago, with the purpose of giving stability to the people of this small world. It was only the incompetence of the younger generations of disciples that allowed the rise of Izumo Sect and the rampant evil cultivators..."

    "Now that the emperor and the immortals from the upper world are slaying evil spirits and purifying the world, Sansheng Pavilion should inherit the legacy of the ancestors and protect the people in the world!"

    An Qixue bowed and said the choice of Sansheng Pavilion.

    Jiang Wuhen also expressed his understanding of this.

    He immediately summoned a saint and two Tribulation Realm Venerables, and said calmly: "From today on, you will sit in the Creation Lotus Realm and become the honorary elders of Sansheng Pavilion. While you are in office, you will report to your family on the situation in this realm at any time. After a hundred years, I will send someone to replace you. When you return to the Jiang family, your monthly salary and other benefits... will be upgraded by one level!"

    After sitting in the small world for a hundred years, after returning, the saint will enjoy the treatment of the saint king, and the venerable will enjoy the treatment of the saint!

    This is simply a gift to them!

    "Don't worry, Emperor, we will fulfill our mission!"

    The three of them bowed and looked respectful.

    Jiang Wuhen nodded, then looked at An Qixue and said calmly: "Sixth Elder, the laws of this small world still need your help..."

    Jiang Qingzhuo walked out from An Qixue. She always protected An Qixue. It was Jiang Qingzhuo who prevented her from burning her origin and healed her injuries!

    She nodded, took out an exquisite crystal stone from her arms, and waved it into the veins of the Lotus Realm.

    "This is the origin of the law of the Middle Thousand World. It is taken from the 'Poseidon Realm' that perished 120,000 years ago. It is enough to make the Lotus Realm of Creation grow into a small world second only to the Middle Thousand World."

    Jiang Qingzhuo explained.

    Everyone in Sansheng Pavilion was shocked when they heard this.

    Taking out the source of the laws of Zhongqian World at will, what a feat!

    The old woman has already felt the changes in the laws of the world, and the restrictions on her realm have begun to loosen.

    She felt that she could hit the Yin and Yang realm at any time!

    Moreover, after the breakthrough, there is no need to ascend to the upper realm.

    At this moment, the mountains, rivers, grass and trees in this small world seemed to come alive, and everything in the world resonated at this moment.

    The will of the world condensed and turned into a ball of light, which descended in front of Jiang Wuhen.

    In an instant, everyone in Sansheng Pavilion was shocked.

    They were born and raised here, and they could recognize at a glance that it was the origin of the will that created the lotus world!

    The world condenses the origin of will, which represents surrender!

    As long as you refine it, you can become the master of the world!

    The ancestors of Sansheng Pavilion have tried various methods, but they have never succeeded.

    At this moment, the Lotus Realm of Creation actively surrenders and offers the source of its will.

    However, Jiang Wuhen didn't even look at it and pushed him in front of An Qixue.

    "Emperor, what are you..."

    An Qixue frowned slightly and said in confusion.

    "I don't need this thing, but you seem to be quite interested..." Jiang Wuhen chuckled and said calmly, "Although you will become my emperor's concubine and will no longer be short of resources, this small world is your foundation after all."

    "If you become the master of the world here, no matter where you are in the future, you can return to the Lotus World of Creation at any time through the origin of the world."
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 27 The Source of Will, the Lord of the World!
